item.title: Strategy Manager
item.description: Lead high impact strategic initiatives and influence key business decisions across Asahi.
item.job:description:
Your Impact

 

Step into a strategy role with real visibility and influence across Asahi Beverages. Reporting to a Head of Strategy, you’ll work across the business on high value strategic priorities that help shape our direction across Oceania.

 

From commercial growth opportunities to broader enterprise challenges, you’ll take on varied, complex work where the answer is not always obvious. You’ll bring together strategic thinking, commercial judgement and rigorous analysis to define the problem, explore the choices and turn insight into recommendations that support important business decisions.

 

You’ll also contribute to the development of our Oceania Mid Term Plan and broader strategic agenda, giving you exposure to both long term direction and the strategic projects helping bring it to life. For someone who enjoys solving different problems, working across functions and seeing their thinking translate into action, this is an opportunity to build breadth and make a meaningful contribution at an enterprise level.

 

Please note, this role will be offered as a 12M fixed term contract.

item.title: Business Development Executive - Retail ACT
item.description: Own a Canberra retail territory, build customer partnerships and grow Asahi’s iconic beverage portfolio.
item.job:description:
Your Impact

Own your patch. Build trusted partnerships. Help great brands win in store.

As a Business Development Executive, you will manage an established independent retail territory across Canberra North, with regular trips to Goulburn, Yass and Crookwell. You will partner with independent bottle shops and grocery customers to grow distribution, improve promotional execution and identify practical opportunities to increase sales, visibility and brand presence.

You will typically visit up to six customers each day and manage a regular fortnightly call cycle. This is a hands-on field sales role with plenty of variety, autonomy and customer contact. FMCG experience is helpful, but it is not essential. If you are confident in sales, organised on the road and keen to learn, we can teach you the industry.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 60 independent liquor and grocery customers
  • Plan and deliver an effective fortnightly customer call cycle
  • Build strong relationships with independent owners and store teams
  • Sell in products, promotions and business initiatives with a value-led approach
  • Grow distribution, volume, visibility and brand presence across the territory
